analyst.summary: YES BANK's Q1 FY27 (Jun-2026) print continued the multi-quarter asset-quality repair story - GNPA 1.3%, NNPA 0.2%, PCR 81.7%, PAT +34% YoY on core NII growth - while NIM (2.7%) and CASA (32.7%, falling sequentially) remain structurally weak versus large private-bank peers, credit cost rose 38.9% YoY despite better headline NPAs, and CRAR eased 110bps YoY to 15.1%. The SMBC ownership overhang is de-risking (20% stake closed May-2025; RBI/CCI have cleared a path to ~25%) but stake increase execution beyond 20% is still pending and management says SMBC synergies aren't yet showing in results. At ~1.4x P/B for a ~7-8% ROE franchise, valuation already leans on continued execution of the RoA-to-1%+ (FY28 guided) path rather than offering a margin of safety.
